summary.text: Ambureen Rana is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 21 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Rana has represented District 21 since 2022 and previously worked in advocacy and community organizing roles.

paragraphs.text: Ambureen Rana lives in Bangor, Maine, and earned a B.S. in biology from the University of Maine.

Her career experience includes working as a program coordinator with the Maine Women's Lobby & MWL Education Fund, a community organizer with Maine Equal Justice, and a health equity center coordinator with the Health Equity Alliance.
Rana won District 21 in 2022, defeating Marianna Reeves and succeeding Heidi Sampson, and won re-election in 2024.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as the Taxation Committee and the Bills in the Second Reading Committee.
Her 2026 general election opponent is Republican Frank Casella.
